_meta.units: mm; X along the fins, Y along the lines, Z up from the die face (datum A); origin at the fin-field centre
_meta.replaces: cad/params.json keys 'cap', 'bosses', 'guard' (provisional v0); also 'separator.outline' and 'separator.outlet/inlet_windows.h_y' via IR-C1/IR-C2
_meta.status: design of record for the cap lane; E1 FEA items O-C1..O-C3 open

cap.material: C10100 OFE sheet 1.00 +-0.03, O60 (annealed), grain <= 0.035 mm; inter-draw anneal 450 C / 30 min N2

skirt.lap: inner face on the core rim lap face 121.40 +-0.05 from z 1.5 (land) to 2.8 (rim top, 0.3 chamfer); lap 1.3 tall; radial gap 0.05 nominal (0.01-0.09 worst case)
skirt.seam: the only external perimeter seam; BAg-8 ring 0.5 wire in the outer corner skirt foot / land, 499 mm, 0.98 g; BN stop-off on the body edge below z 1.5

tap_notches.note: notch edges brazed to the core tap boss (adds 22 mm of seam per notch, same ring)

skirt.clearance_to_stack: grate / web / separator outline 121.0 +-0.08 (IR-C2) -> 0.25 nominal, >= 0.18 min; plenum flanges 120.71, frames 119.0
skirt.stack_edge_cavity: nominally dry: sealed by the lid/separator perimeter band (J6) and by the plenum J3 flange joints; skirt wall is a secondary boundary (44.5 MPa at MAWP if wetted, D-C2)

lands_for_load_frame.backed_by: separator 1.8 over the plenum end frames y 57.0-59.5

arches.end_shape: vertical end, plan radius internal 5.0 / external 6.0 (half cup)

inlet.covers: separator inlet windows at lines |x| <= 46.29 + 2.5 = 48.79 (+1.2 margin)

cross_domes.section: same wall and crown radii as the arches (h_i 7.7, r_i 3.5); plan corners r_i 6.0 / r_e 7.0

inlet.joins: both inlet arches over |x| < 17.5 (valley -16..-12 interrupted there)

outlet.joins: outlet arches 1-3; arch 4 joined by the spine

draw.station_1: arch and dome forming in the flat blank, centre-outward pair by pair with free blank feed from the +-y edges (69 mm total draw-in) and from the +-x margin for the arch ends (equivalent cup ratio 1.97)
draw.station_2: skirt box draw 125 sq, depth 11.6, corners r_i 3.0 (equivalent draw ratio 1.15)
draw.station_3: restrike: skirt corners to r_i 1.0, valleys r 0.5, lid lands flat 0.05; port pockets 26.1 x 1.0; trim; pierce 2 x d20 and tap notches
draw.springback: about 1 deg at r/t 3.5-4.5; die over-bend 1.5 deg; lid land flatness by restrike
draw.build_A: hydroform on soft tools, same sequence

pilot.into: cap port pocket 26.10, radial braze gap 0.05-0.10

bosses.braze: BAg-8 ring 0.6 wire d26.5 in the chamfer corner at the pocket top; face joint 217 mm2 + pocket wall 82 mm2; 5.4 MPa at 3.1 MPa + 200 N side load

stub_seat.face_oring_groove: 1.3 wide x 0.75 deep at d20.3-21.6 in the counterbore floor
stub_seat.lock: boss top lip 0.5 rolled into a 0.3 deep groove on the stub after pressing

stub.top_interface: UQD08 male adapter or 3/4 in hose barb per the ICD; pressed after the post-braze fly-cut
stub.oring: EPDM 70, ID 20.0 x 1.0 section, face seal

guard.material: 316L square weave 50 um absolute (270 mesh, 0.041 wire, 36 % open), 0.5 mm 316L frame
guard.shape: inverted cup under the inlet dome: d30 x 5.0 tall, corrugated bottom 2.5 deep (factor 1.8)
guard.retention: 316L collar d19.6 x 3.0 rising through the d20 hole of the cap top wall, 3 hook tabs 0.3 thick snap above the cap wall inside the boss bore; installed before the cap is placed (pre-braze); boss brazed over it
guard.flow: inside-out: port -> bore -> cup interior -> through the mesh outward and downward -> dome -> inlet arches
guard.alternative: GUARD-A: 25 cm2 pleated element in a d34 x 40 housing on the inlet stub above the boss, serviceable, dP <= 0.2 kPa, +12 mm height at the port only (O-C3)

interface_requests.IR-C1: plenum/separator: separator windows 5.0 x 8.0 (y) at the same centres (plenum top-flat windows stay 5 x 10); window velocity 0.54 m/s, series dP 0.29-0.44 kPa (P4 <= 0.46)
interface_requests.IR-C2: grate/plenum/CAD: GRT-L, GRT-W and SEP outline 121.0 +-0.08 (not 122.6); cap skirt inner 121.5
interface_requests.IR-C3: mech: port bosses at (0,-20) and (0,+21), top z 29.5; lid lands |y| 56.5-59.7 confirmed; inlet arches end |x| 51.0, outlet 57.0
interface_requests.IR-C4: mfg: draw sequence arches-first (station 1), skirt second (station 2), restrike/trim third; guard installed pre-braze; stub seat counterbore 23 H8 with face O-ring and rolled lip; fixture top pad profile to this cap (crown z 20.8, domes 37 x 37 and 37 x 40, pockets)
interface_requests.IR-C5: mfg/BOM: cap mass 279 g (BOM 259.5), blank 188 x 233 (393 g buy); bosses 2 x 19 g unchanged

deviations.D-C1: arch internal 10 x 7.7 (architecture 12 x 8 semicircular, 80.5 mm2): header area -11 %, inlet header 1.05 m/s, +0.11 kPa; needed for a 2 mm drawable valley at the 14 mm window pitch and for 20.8 mm at the bar
deviations.D-C2: skirt wall 44.5 MPa at MAWP if the stack-edge cavity is wetted (two internal joints must fail first); leak-before-break secondary boundary, not a tie
deviations.D-C3: guard 17.4 cm2 / 0.40 kPa clean against 25 cm2 / 0.30 booked; GUARD-A alternative restores both
deviations.D-C4: cap 279 g against the 250 g mech allocation (+29 g): plate 1,307 g on the architecture boundary (target 1,240, limit 1,400)
deviations.D-C5: port bosses moved to y -20 / +21 (architecture CAD -14 / +28) so that a d26 boss sits on a flat dome top
